projects.name: Local Multi-Agent RAG System using GraphRAG
projects.summary: Knowledge-graph-powered retrieval fused with local LLM multi-hop reasoning.
projects.problem: Standard vector-only RAG struggles with multi-hop relationships and global structural queries across interconnected documents.
projects.solution: Designed a local multi-agent GraphRAG pipeline that extracts entities and relationships into a knowledge graph, enabling specialized agents to traverse connected context before synthesis.

projects.name: RAG using LLM (n8n)
projects.summary: Automated RAG and LLM workflow orchestration powered by n8n, Gemini API, and ChromaDB.
projects.problem: Manual document indexing and single-prompt LLM pipelines lack reliability, validation, and automated trigger-based execution.
projects.solution: Engineered an end-to-end n8n automation workflow integrating REST APIs, ChromaDB vector retrieval, and Gemini LLM synthesis with structured JSON validation.
